comment: Upstream reads of uninitialised memory that a ledger entry accounts for. Read by tools/screen-undefined.py; each entry's reproductions are re-screened by --reverify whenever the upstream submodule moves, and verifiedAtUpstreamCommit records the last commit they reproduced on.
